issue.title: ast_edit preview phase does not validate old_string existence

steps: Call ast_edit on src/math.ts with old_string `return a * b;` and new_string `return a - b;` (without force), then call it again with force: true.
expected: The first (preview) ast_edit call reports that old_string was not found in src/math.ts, without a green-light preview.
defect: The preview returns a full preview with "AST validation: PASSED" and "NEXT STEP: Call again with force: true"; only the force call fails with "0 occurrences found".

fault location.explanation: The preview reads the file and builds newContent with applyReplacement directly, never checking that old_string occurs; PR #2029 makes executePreview call calculateEdit first and return its error (e.g. 0 occurrences) before rendering a preview.

Root cause: FIXED UPSTREAM IN https://github.com/vybestack/llxprt-code/pull/2029. ast_edit is a two-step tool: without force it renders a preview, with force: true it applies the edit. In v0.9.3 the preview path (executePreview) reads the file, calls ASTEditTool.applyReplacement (String.replace, which silently does nothing when old_string is absent) and validates the unchanged content, so it reports 'AST validation: PASSED' and tells the caller to re-run with force. Only executeApply goes through calculateEdit, which counts occurrences and returns 'Failed to edit, 0 occurrences found'. Commit e88afa5 (PR #2029, 'Validate ast_edit preview replacements') makes the preview call calculateEdit and return its error, sharing the apply path's validation. The fix first ships in v0.10.0; the pinned v0.11.0 contains it, so the case is tested at v0.9.3.
